title: SPY long-only time-series momentum (price-only)
description: On SPY, a pre-specified long-only time-series momentum rule, adapted from Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012), may offer improved downside-risk characteristics relative to passive SPY exposure over selected historical regimes, after realistic execution costs. The original paper studied a broad futures universe; this experiment tests a single US ETF with $100 capital and no leverage. This is a hypothesis, not a claim of profit.
citations: Moskowitz, Tobias J., Yao Hua Ooi, and Lasse Heje Pedersen. 2012. Time Series Momentum. Journal of Financial Economics 104 (2): 228-250. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jfineco.2011.11.003
White, Halbert. 2000. A Reality Check for Data Snooping. Econometrica 68 (5): 1097-1126. https://doi.org/10.1111/1468-0262.00152
Bailey, David H., and Marcos Lopez de Prado. 2014. The Deflated Sharpe Ratio. Journal of Portfolio Management 40 (5): 94-107. https://doi.org/10.3905/jpm.2014.40.5.094
caveats: Price-only research: raw closes exclude dividends; not a total-return comparison.
Signal uses completed session closes; simulated fills occur at the next session open.
Parameters were fixed before examining results. No optimization grid was run.
Train/validation/test windows document sample regimes. Parameters were not fitted on train.
Sharpe and Sortino are descriptive only. Short samples and selection bias remain.
Reproducibility rerun of the same pre-registered rule. Missing momentum is insufficient data, not a cash signal. Parameters were not changed.
